summary: Checked all three estimates after reading the complete 16-page paper markdown, including the final references, and extracting the relevant PDF pages with pymupdf. Table 1 was also recovered with find_tables. All recorded means, SDs, analyzed arm counts and pairwise p-value bounds match PDF p. 9 and refer to the correct outcome and arms. Two comparison_type entries should be ai_vs_active because TDL used printed and online reference aids. The remaining requested coding fields are supported. All three reported design-achievement contrasts are present; the other measured outcomes are self-reports, and separate rubric-dimension results are not reported in the supplied paper. The inconsistency between the paper's arm summaries and its reported significance is already disclosed in the extraction and is not a transcription error. Supplementary Table S1 could not be independently inspected: requests to the named Frontiers and Figshare APIs using User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 both failed with WinError 10013, and no local copy was found in the searched locations. The paper identifies it as the design operation sheet; completeness beyond the supplied paper remains unconfirmed.
